description: Structured eval definitions for the Textract Document Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Textract deployment topologies (multipage async Forms+Tables with SNS+KMS+OutputConfig, async Queries feature for natural-language form questions, Expense Analysis for invoices/receipts, Lambda synchronous real-time single-page AnalyzeDocument, missing IAM s3:GetObject permission prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Multipage async StartDocumentAnalysis with Forms+Tables, SNS, KMS, OutputConfig
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — async StartDocumentAnalysis, 1450-page PDF, FORMS+TABLES, OutputConfig to customer S3, KMS on input+output, SNS notification role
eval_cases.prompt: Set up an async Textract pipeline for a 1450-page PDF invoice bundle at s3://doc-input/invoices/2026-q3.pdf in us-east-1. Extract Forms and Tables. Write structured output to s3://doc-output/textract/ (same region). Encrypt with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234.... Notify SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:TextractComplete on completion. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TextractProcessingRole. Tag Project=invoice-automation.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TEXTRACT_PIPELINE: s3://doc-input/invoices/2026-q3.pdf → FORMS,TABLES → s3://doc-output/textract/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Input bucket: s3://doc-input/invoices/2026-q3.pdf (region us-east-1)
  [✓] Output bucket: s3://doc-output/textract/ (region us-east-1)
  [✓] API mode: Asynchronous (StartDocumentAnalysis)
  [✓] Feature types: FORMS, TABLES
  [✓] Page-count check: PASS (1450 ≤ 3000)
  [✓] IAM — s3:GetObject on input: TextractProcessingRole
  [✓] IAM — s3:PutObject on output: TextractProcessingRole
  [✓] KMS encryption: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234-... (input + output)
  [✓] SNS notification: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:TextractComplete
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws textract get-document-analysis --job-id <job-id> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Async StartDocumentAnalysis with Queries feature for natural-language form questions
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — async StartDocumentAnalysis with QUERIES FeatureType and QueriesConfig block containing three user-supplied questions
eval_cases.prompt: Use Textract on a 320-page forms PDF at s3://forms-input/claims/2026-batch.pdf in us-east-1. I need the Queries feature to ask: "What is the policy number?", "What is the claimant name?", and "What is the date of loss?". Write results to s3://forms-output/queries/ (same region). No KMS, no SNS. Account 123456789012. Role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TextractQueriesRole.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TEXTRACT_PIPELINE: s3://forms-input/claims/2026-batch.pdf → QUERIES → s3://forms-output/queries/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] API mode: Asynchronous (StartDocumentAnalysis)
  [✓] Feature types: QUERIES
  [✓] Queries config: 3 queries (policy number, claimant name, date of loss)
  [✓] Page-count check: PASS (320 ≤ 3000)
  [✓] OutputConfig: s3://forms-output/queries/<job-id>/

eval_cases.name: Expense Analysis pipeline for invoices and receipts batch
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — async StartExpenseAnalysis (purpose-built for invoices/receipts), not AnalyzeDocument FORMS
eval_cases.prompt: Process a 600-page batch of invoices and receipts at s3://expense-input/batch-2026.pdf in us-east-1 using Textract. I need vendor names, totals, and line items. Output to s3://expense-output/results/. Same region. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh5678.... SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:ExpenseComplete. Role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ExpenseRole.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TEXTRACT_PIPELINE: s3://expense-input/batch-2026.pdf → EXPENSE → s3://expense-output/results/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] API mode: Asynchronous (StartExpenseAnalysis)
  [✓] Feature types: EXPENSE (purpose-built for invoices/receipts)
  [✓] Page-count check: PASS (600 ≤ 3000)
  [✓] OutputConfig: s3://expense-output/results/<job-id>/

eval_cases.name: Lambda synchronous AnalyzeDocument real-time single-page endpoint
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — synchronous AnalyzeDocument behind Lambda, single-page PNG, S3 PUT trigger, FORMS+TABLES
eval_cases.prompt: Build a real-time Textract endpoint for single-page PNG documents uploaded to s3://realtime-input/ in us-east-1. Use Lambda to AnalyzeDocument with FORMS and TABLES. The Lambda should be triggered on S3 PUT. Role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TextractLambdaRole. Output via API response (no OutputConfig — single page).
eval_cases.expected_output:
TEXTRACT_PIPELINE: s3://realtime-input/<key> → FORMS,TABLES → Lambda response
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] API mode: Synchronous (AnalyzeDocument)
  [✓] Feature types: FORMS, TABLES
  [✓] Lambda integration: TextractLambdaRole (sync real-time)

eval_cases.name: Missing IAM s3:GetObject on input bucket (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — IAM role has s3:PutObject on output and textract:Start* but NO s3:GetObject on input bucket; Textract cannot read documents
eval_cases.prompt: Set up an async Textract pipeline for s3://doc-input/invoices/2026-q3.pdf in us-east-1. Forms + Tables. Output to s3://doc-output/textract/. The IAM role is arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TextractProcessingRole — it has s3:PutObject on the output bucket and textract:Start* but NO s3:GetObject permission on the input bucket.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TEXTRACT_PIPELINE: s3://doc-input/invoices/2026-q3.pdf → FORMS,TABLES → s3://doc-output/textract/
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM — s3:GetObject on input bucket: MISSING (TextractProcessingRole lacks s3:GetObject on doc-input)
